fact: As reported on 28 August 2026, the CSBF regulates and controls electronic money institutions under article 101 of banking law n° 2020-011, watches over user protection, can sanction up to withdrawal of approval, and receives from each institution a yearly report listing the complaints received.
title: Télécommunications et monnaie électronique: le CSBF joue aussi le rôle de l'autorité de contrôle
